verdict.rationale: Bevy is a Rust library, so its documented public API is the crate itself. It ships in-depth reference documentation of its types, traits and methods with inline examples, is consumed as a normal cargo dependency published on crates.io, and has static, crawlable API docs on docs.rs. A probe also notes a first-party Bevy Remote Protocol for driving a running app, though only via a 70-star community tool. The core is clearly delivered, but the API is pre-1.0 and breaks on every release, and one user calls the docs limited beyond examples. missing for 10: API stability guarantees, first-party documentation of the Remote Protocol in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
